{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the actual number of sites
actual_sites = df['site'].unique()
print(f'Actual sites: {actual_sites}')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_unique_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_unique_patients}')

# Compute response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)
print(f'Response rates by site:
{response_rate_by_site}')

# Extract the highest response rate
max_response_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()
print(f'Highest response rate: {max_response_rate}')

# Identify the site with the highest response rate
site_with_highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
print(f'Site with highest response rate: {site_with_highest_rate}')"}
